Provide total template fees directly so external mining clients avoid summing individual fees over IPC
agreement: Verified by testing the data race fix with TSAN (enirox001)
Support with an added functional test covering concurrent template access (ismaelsadeeq)
Suggests making the template non-mutating rather than adding a mutex (sedited)
